summary: Backend + frontend regression + new-feature test for Fase 5 (multi-shot stitching) and 'Riempi area con texture' (fill pattern). Backend pytest suite added at /app/backend/tests/test_stitch_and_fill.py (16 tests, 16 PASS): (a) /api/geometry/fill: diamond/semplice returns border_count=0 & line_count>0; diamond/bordato returns border_count>=1 & line_count>0 (validated polylines = border + pattern lists); cross/bordato and lines/semplice also validated; invalid contour returns 422. (b) Multi-shot flow: create project (capture_mode=multi) -> POST /shots twice with /tmp/shot1.jpg & /tmp/shot2.jpg (regenerated via /tmp/test_stitch.py) -> both n_markers>=4 -> GET /shots returns 2 with photo_urls -> POST /stitch returns anchored=[both ids], unanchored=[], contour_points>=4 (actual 8), plane_w_mm/plane_h_mm >0 (1384x884mm), rectified_url set -> DELETE /shots/{id} removes one, list confirms 1 remaining. (c) Single-shot regression: create -> POST /photo (/tmp/synthetic.jpg regenerated via /tmp/test_pipeline.py) -> POST /process (status=processed, quality valid, contour>=4) -> preview cut_count>=1 -> export size>0. Frontend Playwright (mobile 390x844): New Project shows 'Modalità cattura' segmented [SCATTO SINGOLO / MULTI-SCATTO]; selecting MULTI-SCATTO shows info box 'Per aree fino a 2×3 m' and button label switches from AVVIA CAMERA -> GESTISCI SCATTI; submit navigates to /shots/{id}; stitch button shows 'UNISCI E VETTORIALIZZA (0)' and is disabled when empty. Existing multi project 6a804ed25c6e75253e658707: 2 shot cards render with '6 bollini rilevati', tags 'OK MARKER' + 'AGGANCIATO', SCATTA/GALLERIA visible, stitch btn '(2)'; tapping stitch calls backend and navigates to /editor/{id} showing 1137.6×476.1mm rectified plane with 8 contour nodes. Editor TEXTURE mode: 'RIEMPI AREA CON TEXTURE' button opens fill modal with DIAMANTE/INCROCIATO/RIGHE, PASSO input, SEMPLICE/BORDATO, INCISIONE/TAGLIO, RIEMPI; selecting DIAMANTE+BORDATO+RIEMPI adds FILL element with ENGRAVE layer and pattern renders on canvas. Regression: 'AGGIUNGI SCRITTA / FORMA / SVG' opens the existing add-element modal with TEXT/SVG/TRACK/RECT/CIRCLE/LINE. Background image sizing (rectified_w_px*mm_per_px) works for the multi-shot project (contour and grid align). No React Native red screens; deprecated packages: none new.

critical_code_review_comments: stitch.py correctly anchors first shot via 4 corner markers -> known ref rectangle and iteratively matches subsequent shots via RANSAC similarity upgraded to homography with >=4 pairs — matches the problem statement.

geometry_ops.fill_pattern implements 'bordato' via poly.buffer(-border_mm) inset and clips hatching to inset field for both DIAMOND (2 hatches ±angle), CROSS (angle & angle+90), LINES; polylines returned to caller = border + pattern (server returns border_count/line_count separately).
server.py /api/geometry/fill correctly returns 422 when contour has <3 points.
Frontend TexturePanel exposes both 'RIEMPI AREA CON TEXTURE' (fill-area-btn) and 'AGGIUNGI SCRITTA / FORMA / SVG' (add-element-btn) — no regression to prior element flow.
Frontend new-project.tsx correctly routes to /shots/{id} when capture_mode=multi and /capture?id={id} when single.
